coverage_assessment: Open-web first pass recorded 19 search invocations and 564 captured result headers. Search coverage used French and English terms across January week windows and adjacent-month boundaries, including political/security, student, labor/municipal, rights/media, and coup/mutiny versus civilian gathering leads, with Ouagadougou, Bobo-Dioulasso, Kaya and other reported locations. Seven current source cards contain observed body text. Findings remain provisional: archive/hemeroteca and LexisNexis coverage is unavailable; search-only, held and technically unretrievable sources remain gaps; event ownership and crowd/response fields are not inferred across dates or cities.
